name: Read member savings balance
description: Look up a member by their 5-digit Member ID and return the current balance of their Savings account. Read-only: this capability never modifies the member record.

memberId.description: The member's 5-digit identifier, as printed on their statement.

savingsBalance.description: Current balance of the member's Savings account, exactly as displayed (e.g. '8,417.32'). Carried as a string; do not parse as a float.

steps.note: Loads the frameset shell. Every later step works inside the 'content' frame.
Typing into a field stages nothing on the server; the read happens on submit.
